# Blockchain Network

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:BlockchainNetwork`](gmeow-BlockchainNetwork.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/BlockchainNetwork>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A blockchain network identified by a chain identifier (e.g. CAIP-2 [`chainId`](../properties/gmeow-chainId.md)).

## Structure

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:BlockchainNetwork`](gmeow-BlockchainNetwork.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to model the distributed-ledger network a transaction, contract, or account belongs to — identified by its chain id (CAIP-2) — when the chain context is needed to interpret on-chain evidence.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for an individual block, transaction, or account on the network (those are their own classes); the network is the chain itself, not its records.

### How to use

- Mint the network with [`gmeow:chainId`](../properties/gmeow-chainId.md) (the EL minimum, e.g. eip155:1); reference it from [`gmeow:SmartContract`](gmeow-SmartContract.md), [`gmeow:BlockchainAccount`](gmeow-BlockchainAccount.md), and [`gmeow:LedgerTransaction`](gmeow-LedgerTransaction.md) so on-chain identifiers resolve against the right chain.

### Examples

- ex:ethMainnet a [`gmeow:BlockchainNetwork`](gmeow-BlockchainNetwork.md); [`gmeow:chainId`](../properties/gmeow-chainId.md) "eip155:1".
